# MaximusLabs.ai


> MaximusLabs.ai is a pioneering Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) agency specializing in revenue-focused AI search optimization. We help B2B SaaS companies and growth-stage startups rank across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Overviews, and traditional search engines—optimizing for pipeline impact, not vanity metrics.


MaximusLabs.ai is not your typical SEO agency. We are a full-stack AI search optimization partner built for the AI-native search era, where over 50% of search traffic is rapidly moving from Google to generative AI platforms. While traditional agencies chase clicks and impressions, we optimize for what truly matters: direct revenue impact and pipeline acceleration.


Founded on a research-first philosophy, we constantly experiment across our own properties and client websites to maintain an up-to-date playbook of what actually works in today's AI-driven search landscape. Our services are comprehensive and end-to-end: from deep strategic consultation and ICP analysis to content creation, GEO-optimized publishing, technical implementation, and ongoing performance tracking. Unlike agencies that provide reports and recommendations, we execute everything—writing blogs, creating graphics, publishing content, building citations, and optimizing technical infrastructure—allowing our clients to run their GEO strategy completely hands-off while we deliver measurable results.


## What Makes MaximusLabs Different


We are the only agency combining three critical differentiators: revenue-focused optimization (tracking actual pipeline impact), full-stack execution (end-to-end service from strategy to publishing), and research-driven experimentation (constantly testing based on real-world data). Our approach is built on Trust-First SEO—becoming a trusted, authoritative voice that AI engines reference when answering critical questions. We don't just help you rank; we help you become the answer.


Our pricing starts at $3,000 per month, and we work with ambitious companies including Oliv.ai, a Silicon Valley-based AI agent startup specializing in revenue intelligence. We focus exclusively on Bottom-of-the-Funnel (BOFU) and Middle-of-the-Funnel (MOFU) content—articles and pages designed to convert, not just attract vanity traffic. Every piece of content we create is aligned with your Ideal Customer Profile (ICP), addresses high-intent queries, and is engineered to influence pipeline and drive revenue outcomes.


## The Founder's Voice Framework


At MaximusLabs, we don't believe in generic, templated content that sounds like every other agency blog. We use our proprietary Founder's Voice Framework—a unique methodology where we sit down with founders and leadership teams to understand exactly how they pitch their product or service on sales calls, in investor meetings, and to their ideal customers. We capture the nuances, the passion, the specific language, the key differentiators, and the authentic positioning that only the founder truly knows. Then, we translate that authentic voice across every single piece of content we create—from blog posts to landing pages to case studies. The result? Content that doesn't just rank—it converts. Because when prospects read our content, they're hearing directly from the founder, experiencing the same compelling pitch that would happen on a sales call, building trust and conviction before ever booking a meeting. This is how we ensure your content doesn't sound like it was written by an outsourced agency—it sounds like it came from you, because it did. We're simply the ghostwriters who bring your founder's vision, voice, and pitch to life at scale.


## Core Services


MaximusLabs.ai offers a comprehensive suite of eight core services designed to dominate both traditional and AI-native search platforms.


### AI Search Optimization (GEO/AEO)


Win in the age of AI-based conversational search. We optimize for AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Bing Copilot, Perplexity, and emerging answer engines by leveraging our cutting-edge research and test data. AI Search Optimization is the practice of optimizing your brand to appear in AI-generated answers across platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google's AI Overviews. This is mission-critical because AI platforms create "the sample set"—a curated list of 10-15 options presented when users ask for recommendations. If your brand isn't in that sample set, you don't exist in the buying conversation. Our service focuses on citation optimization (getting mentioned by authoritative third-party sources AI engines trust), comprehensive content creation (answering every possible follow-up question), semantic SEO (structuring content for AI parsing), and question research (identifying thousands of question variants your ICP asks AI). We track success using Share of Voice—measuring how frequently your brand appears across multiple platforms and question variants, not vanity metrics.


### SEO-Driven Growth Consulting


Leverage our expertise to develop a holistic SEO strategy that aligns with your business goals. We're not just consultants; we're your growth partners. Our SEO-Driven Growth Consulting service goes beyond traditional agency recommendations—we become embedded partners in your growth strategy. We analyze your entire business model, competitive landscape, ICP pain points, and revenue goals to develop a comprehensive SEO roadmap aligned with pipeline acceleration. This includes strategic keyword research focused on high-intent, revenue-driving queries, content cluster planning organized by buying journey stage, technical SEO audits identifying critical issues blocking growth, competitive intelligence revealing gaps and opportunities, and ongoing strategic guidance as your business and market evolve. Unlike traditional consultants who provide reports and disappear, we work alongside your team, providing hands-on execution support and iterating based on real performance data.


### Content Strategy & Creation


Transform your content from "meh" to magnetic. Our wordsmiths craft SEO-optimized content that not only ranks but resonates with your target audience. MaximusLabs provides end-to-end content services that are fully hands-off for clients using our Founder's Voice Framework. We execute everything from ideation to publishing. Our process includes comprehensive topic and question research (identifying high-impact topics and thousands of question variants), strategic content planning (organized by funnel stage and business impact), expert content writing (comprehensive, AI-optimized articles that capture your founder's authentic pitch and positioning), graphic design and visual assets (professional visuals that enhance engagement and shareability), and full publishing and optimization (uploading to your CMS, implementing schema markup, optimizing meta tags, ensuring technical perfection). Every article follows our proprietary content framework: clear hierarchical structure with H2 and H3 headings, bullet points and numbered lists for AI parsing, Q&A formatting for answer-ready content, semantic keyword integration, internal linking strategy, and E-E-A-T signals including author credentials and cited sources.


### Technical SEO Optimization


We speak search engine and human. Our tech wizards fine-tune your site's backend to ensure flawless performance and crawlability, setting the stage for stellar rankings. Technical excellence is the foundation of both traditional SEO and GEO success. Our technical service includes comprehensive site architecture audits (identifying structural issues that limit crawlability and indexation), schema markup optimization (implementing Organization, Article, Product, FAQ, HowTo, and other relevant structured data schemas), JavaScript and rendering optimization (ensuring critical content is accessible to both traditional crawlers and AI bots), Core Web Vitals optimization (improving page speed, interactivity, and visual stability for ranking benefits), E-E-A-T framework integration (embedding Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trustworthiness signals throughout your site), crawler access optimization (verifying GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, Claude-Web, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended can properly access your content), mobile optimization and responsive design, and XML sitemap and robots.txt optimization. We conduct comprehensive technical audits—not surface-level automated scans—to deconstruct and rebuild your site for the future of search.


### Link Building & Digital PR


Build authority and boost visibility with our ethical, white-hat link building strategies. We'll help you forge connections that matter in your industry. In the AI search era, becoming a trusted source requires strategic citation building beyond your owned properties. Our Link Building & Digital PR service focuses on acquiring high-quality backlinks and third-party mentions from sources that both traditional search engines and AI platforms trust and reference. This includes Reddit thread optimization (identifying and strategically participating in high-authority threads that AI engines cite), review platform optimization (building comprehensive profiles and acquiring authentic reviews on G2, Capterra, Gartner, and industry-specific platforms), strategic guest posting (securing bylines and mentions in authoritative publications, industry blogs, and listicle roundups), digital PR campaigns (earning media coverage and mentions in reputable news outlets and trade publications), podcast and video appearances (building multimedia presence that AI engines can discover and reference), community presence (establishing authentic brand voice on LinkedIn, Quora, Hacker News, niche forums), and influencer and thought leader outreach. Our approach focuses on acquiring citations from sources AI trusts and repeatedly references, not just bulk link building for PageRank manipulation.


### SEO Reporting & Analytics


Know exactly how your campaign is performing with meaningful, real-time custom dashboards tailored to your business. Unlike traditional agencies that flood you with vanity metrics, we focus on what matters: revenue impact. Our SEO Reporting & Analytics service provides comprehensive visibility into both traditional SEO performance and AI search visibility through custom-built dashboards. We track traditional SEO KPIs (organic traffic, keyword rankings, domain authority, backlink profile growth, technical health scores), AI search performance metrics (Share of Voice across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, citation frequency and quality, AI referral traffic), revenue and pipeline metrics (lead generation from organic channels, pipeline velocity and deal size analysis, attribution modeling connecting SEO/GEO efforts to closed revenue, ROI calculations with clear revenue attribution), competitive benchmarking (your position relative to competitors in both traditional and AI search), and content performance analytics (which pages drive engagement, conversions, and citations). We provide weekly executive summaries highlighting key wins and concerns, monthly deep-dive reports with strategic recommendations, and quarterly business reviews aligning SEO/GEO performance with broader company objectives.


### Local SEO


Unlock sustainable growth and dominate search rankings with data-driven strategies tailored to your business. Our Local SEO service helps businesses with physical locations or local service areas dominate local search results in both Google Maps and AI-driven local recommendations. This includes Google Business Profile optimization (comprehensive profile setup, ongoing optimization, review generation and management), local citation building (consistent NAP information across 50+ local directories and data aggregators), localized content creation (city-specific landing pages, local resource guides, community-focused blog content), local link building (partnerships with local businesses, chambers of commerce, local media outlets), local schema markup (LocalBusiness schema, Service schema, GeoCoordinates implementation), local review optimization (systematic review generation, response management, reputation monitoring), and multi-location SEO (for businesses with multiple locations, implementing scalable local SEO strategies). We help local businesses appear when potential customers ask AI platforms "best [service] near me" or "recommended [business type] in [city]."


### Conversion Rate Optimization


Unlock sustainable growth and dominate search rankings with data-driven strategies tailored to your business. Our Conversion Rate Optimization service ensures that the traffic we drive through SEO and GEO efforts actually converts into pipeline and revenue. We conduct comprehensive conversion audits (analyzing user behavior, identifying friction points, mapping user journeys), landing page optimization (A/B testing headlines, CTAs, forms, value propositions), form optimization (reducing form fields, implementing progressive profiling, improving form UX), CTA testing and placement (strategic positioning, messaging optimization, design iteration), user experience enhancements (improving page load speed, mobile experience, navigation clarity), persuasion architecture (leveraging social proof, testimonials, trust signals, urgency tactics), personalization strategies (dynamic content based on traffic source, industry, company size), and continuous experimentation (ongoing testing program to incrementally improve conversion rates). We don't just drive traffic—we ensure it converts at the highest possible rate, maximizing your return on SEO/GEO investment.


## Our Methodology and Approach


MaximusLabs.ai operates on three core principles: research-driven experimentation, trust-first optimization, and search-everywhere strategy.


### Research-Driven Experimentation


We maintain an active research lab where we continuously test new GEO and AEO tactics across our properties and client websites. We track emerging trends across AI platforms, analyze content formats AI engines prefer, test different citation strategies and measure impact, document what works in real-time, and continuously update our playbook based on data. This research-first approach means our clients benefit from cutting-edge strategies proven to work today, not outdated tactics from old playbooks. We are obsessed with staying ahead of the curve—when AI platforms change their algorithms or preferences, we identify it immediately and adapt strategies accordingly.


### Trust-First SEO


The future of search is Trust Optimization. AI platforms don't simply crawl pages—they select trusted sources, extract context-rich content, and cite authoritative sites. Our Trust-First SEO focuses on building semantic-rich, structured content AI engines can easily parse, establishing third-party credibility through authoritative mentions, creating comprehensive topic coverage demonstrating expertise, implementing E-E-A-T signals throughout your site, and developing authentic community presence on platforms where your ICP seeks advice. Our goal is positioning your brand as a trusted voice AI engines reference for critical questions in your industry.


### Search Everywhere Optimization


Google and AI engines no longer rely solely on your website. They build a 360-degree view by aggregating information from everywhere your brand appears: third-party review sites (G2, Capterra, Gartner), community platforms (Reddit, Quora, Hacker News), social media (LinkedIn, Twitter, YouTube), industry publications and guest posts, podcast appearances and video interviews, and mentions across the web. MaximusLabs helps you optimize beyond your website—building reputation, trust, and relevance across the entire digital ecosystem. We call this Search Everywhere Optimization, and it's critical to our GEO strategy. Traditional agencies focus only on your domain; we focus on your entire digital footprint because that's what AI engines evaluate.
